text:
maria.chen: Quick flag — Orchids Labs (contract OL-2029-07) got two invoices with the prepaid commit credit applied twice. Looks like revenue for Apr was fully recognized but we should have deferred part for the remaining term. Need revrec adjustment and guidance on reversing accruals. Invoices INV-2029-4532 and INV-2029-4533.

tom.hagen: ugh. Do we know how much was over-recognized?

maria.chen: ~72,450 USD. Calculation summary: committed $300,000 prepaid, applied 240k to current, but the distro code applied extra credits across multiple invoices resulting in 72,450 overrecognized in Apr.

kevin.ng: Can you paste the query you used to calc? I'll pull the GL and confirm.

maria.chen: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, amount, applied_credit, contract_term_months
FROM billing.applied_credits
WHERE contract_id='OL-2029-07'
ORDER BY created_at;
```

billing-bot: billing-bot: AUTO-APPLY: credit OL-2029-07 applied to INV-2029-4532 and INV-2029-4533 (run 1868998000) :white_check_mark:

elaine.ops: we should create a reversing J/E for 72,450 to move revenue back to deferred revenue. Tag GL: 4001-DeferredRevenue. @kevin.ng can you sign off? Need to post before month-end close.

kevin.ng: I can sign. Need a short memo + calculation detail. maria please paste the worksheet or numbers here.

maria.chen: attaching quick calc (pasted):
Total prepaid: 300,000
Applied to invoices: 272,450
Expected recognized to date: 200,000 (for example period)
Over-recognized = 72,450
(worksheet link below)

tom.hagen: can you upload the billing run export that shows the credit application IDs?

maria.chen: upload: https://redwood-internal.s3/finance/OL-2029-07-revrec-worksheet.csv

kevin.ng: reviewed worksheet. Confirm over-recognized = 72,450. Approve reversing JE with memo: "Correcting over-recognition of prepaid commit — duplicate credit application (billing auto-apply)." I'll route approval to Elaine for posting.

elaine.ops: creating reversing journal now. JE# 2029-APR-REV-001 created (pending posting). Posting description includes contract id and invoice references.

maria.chen: thanks. Also need a remediation plan so this doesn't recur — tagging eng-billing. @tom.hagen please follow up on the auto-apply logic.

tom.hagen: filing ticket FE-3247 to add dedupe check (contract + month + credit id). Will link billing run and tests.

billing-bot: TICKET CREATED FE-3247 - Duplicate credit safeguard. Assigned tom.hagen.

cfo_lucas: include impact on ARR and deferred revenue schedule in tomorrow's close pack and note the JE.

maria.chen: will add updated rev schedule chart and a one-line note in the close pack. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
